name: Copy for Email and Chat

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
**The plugin is now Copy for Email and Chat.** (0.1.3 briefly used an ampersand in the name, which the community directory disallows — if you're coming from 0.1.2, everything below is new.) Plugin id is unchanged; nothing to do on your end.

## Chat-styled plain text

The plain-text clipboard flavor (what WeChat, Slack and iMessage paste) now redraws structure with glyphs instead of flattening it: 【h1】 / ■ h2 / ▍h3 / ・h4+ headings, 「」 around bold and highlight, ①–⑳ ordered items, ▏ quote bars, ※ callout titles, full-width nesting indents.

## Marker settings

Every glyph is configurable in the new **Plain text** settings section. A style dropdown offers **Chat glyphs** (default) or **Minimal** — the exact undecorated output of previous versions.

## Ribbon button

A mail icon in the ribbon copies the selection if there is one (editor or reading view), otherwise the whole note. Hide it via Obsidian's ribbon configuration if you don't want it.
